rows.unit: model pipeline stage / instructions per cycle
rows.scope: Fetch buffer separates fetch and decode; model decodes up to two instructions per cycle. The one-boundary prior excludes cache wait and issue delay.
Variable collector residency follows bank arbitration and operand count. A constant one-cycle collector delay is not supported.
